description: T349 chrome stability fixtures. Rows expected to fail are pre-fix reproducers; the owning task flips its row to pass when the fix lands.

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, default status row, Wi-Fi model; open Wi-Fi from its status item
cases.symptom: popup.x and dropdownX are 0 instead of the clamped anchor x (500)

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, default status row, audio model; open Volume from its status item
cases.symptom: popup.x and dropdownX are 0 instead of the clamped anchor x (520)

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, default status row, battery model; open Battery from its status item
cases.symptom: popup.x and dropdownX are 0 instead of the clamped anchor x (520)

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, Bluetooth status item available, Bluetooth model; open Bluetooth from its status item
cases.symptom: popup.x and dropdownX are 0 instead of the clamped anchor x (500)

cases.setup: MenuBar width 360, all four status items available; open Battery near the right edge
cases.symptom: popup.x is 0 instead of the right-edge clamp (80)

cases.setup: Bottom Dock 1280x160 with a two-window entry; open the real Dock window chooser
cases.symptom: popoverRect ends at the popup box; the rotated arrow tip extends about 1.66 logical px below the committed crop

cases.setup: Bottom Dock 1280x160 with a two-window entry; open the real Dock window chooser
cases.symptom: the material descriptor covers the full popup rectangle, including the empty bands beside the arrow

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, clock status item; click the clock
cases.symptom: guards the working DateTimePanel box while T350 fixes the four status hosts

cases.setup: Popup with materialPreset menuAttached over a 16 px checkerboard; QML shadow hidden
cases.symptom: attached menus must keep square top corners and rounded bottom corners

cases.setup: Popup with materialPreset menuDetached over a 16 px checkerboard; QML shadow hidden
cases.symptom: detached menus must leave all four rounded corners transparent

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800, Wi-Fi model; open, close, then reopen the Wi-Fi popover
cases.symptom: the cold and warm opens must keep the same anchor and target width, and a closed popover must commit no target

cases.setup: Bottom Dock 1280x160 with Files (2 windows) and Notes (3 windows); open, close, switch, reopen
cases.symptom: the chooser must follow the live entry and retire input at logical close

cases.setup: MenuBar width 800 with one File app menu; open, close, reopen
cases.symptom: the attached menu card must stay current across a close/reopen
